name: Phillip Scheel
occupation: Hot Springs County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Phillip Scheel is a Hot Springs County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Thomas J. Ryan, who is serving through the current term. The Thermopolis Independent Record reported that unofficial primary results showed him with 613 votes, advancing with Chip Axtell.
